text:
The plate is roughly 350 px wide in the image. If it is a square dinner plate of about 24 cm, that gives roughly 0.07 cm per px.

Each corn piece is about 95 px across, which is about 6.5 cm. Each is a cross-cut round of a cob about 3–4 cm thick.

Volume of one piece: π × 3.25² × 3.5 ≈ 116 cm³. The cob core takes up some of that, and the kernels are dense, so I estimate about 0.7 g/cm³ effective, or about 80 g per piece.

Two pieces come to about 160 g. The cob is a large part of the weight, but cob weight counts here as well.
